Applicant :- Vipul Singh Alias Nishant Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Prashant Kumar Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Prashant Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya,
learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
0008 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC & Sections 60, 64, 72 U.P. Excise Act,
Police Station- Myorpur, District- Sonebhadra, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and four others and according to FIR, from the possession of applicant and other accused persons 350 liter illicit liquor was recovered.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, applicant has Vipul Singh Alias Nishant Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109378625/
1 been made accused in the present matter along with four others.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He further submitted that all the other four accused persons have already been released on bail and their bail orders have been annexed along with supplementary affidavit dated 15.04.2024.
6.
He further submitted that apart from the present case, however, applicant was made accused in one another case but in that case after investigation final report has been submitted.
He further submitted that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 23.01.2024.
7. Per contra, learned AGA however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, from the possession of applicant and four others 350 liter illicit liquor alleged to have been recovered but all the other four accused persons have already been released on bail by this Court and applicant is in jail in the present matter since January, 2024 and he is not having any criminal history, therefore, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant- Vipul Singh Alias Nishant Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
12. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

13. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 KK Patel  Vipul Singh Alias Nishant Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109378625/
